dedupe_keys.name: obstetric patient flow simulation metamodel experiments

description: obflowsim-mm publishes the Isken research project's experiments on metamodels for obstetric patient-flow simulation. It combines a simple SimPy inpatient flow model with input and output processing and scripts for fitting and comparing surrogate models. Inputs are scenario recipes, simulation configurations and generated experiment outputs; outputs are fitted metamodels, accuracy comparisons and paper figures. Coverage is a synthetic obstetric unit network, not an identified hospital, with experiment-specific run lengths and replications. Source is free under MIT, with a conda environment, an explainer notebook and three documented experiment pipelines. A limitation is substantial computation: one described experiment has more than 3,000 scenarios with 25 replications and can take 10–20 hours; the simplified network limits operational generalisation. The resource can test surrogate methods for healthcare capacity simulations. obflowsim (model-obflowsim) now owns continued development of the core flow model. No simulation outputs or experiment datasets were downloaded.
